主要内容: Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc. entered into a Senior Subordinated Convertible Loan and Security Agreement with Robert J. Pallé and Carol M. Pallé on February 11, 2016. The agreement provides a delayed draw term loan facility of up to $600,000, with an initial advance of $200,000 and a commitment for additional advances up to $400,000. Interest accrues at 12% annually, payable monthly in-kind or in cash. The loan may be converted into common stock at $0.54 per share, subject to stockholder approval. The obligations are secured by the company’s and its subsidiary’s assets, including a mortgage. The agreement terminates three years from the closing date. A mortgage on the company’s headquarters in Old Bridge, New Jersey, is subordinate to a prior mortgage in favor of Santander Bank, N.A. A Subordination Agreement was signed on February 11, 2016, making Santander’s rights superior to the Pallé Loan Agreement. The company disclosed a previous $1,000,000 investment proposal from ZyCast Technology, Inc., which ended due to lack of agreement. The report was signed by Eric Skolnik, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, on February 12, 2016.
